MUSIC AND DANCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

2. Best practice when working on Kenyan Contemporary Songs: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Contemporary Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Classical Music and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Music and Dance Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. A — Practise Kenyan Contemporary Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. C — Practise Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. B — Practise Instrumental Transpositions with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. D — Practise Music Notation Software. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. D — Practise Contemporary Songs from Kenya with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. A — Practise Western Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. D — Practise Western Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. A — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

10. C — Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. A — Practise Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. B — Practise Four-Part Harmony with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Contemporary Songs; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Music and Dance Industry; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Rhythm; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
